description: Single-server Coolify deployment. All services on one host. Public *.${PUBLIC_TLD}; internal services reach each other via Docker network (no mesh needed). TLDs + cookie domains come from operator env / config/domains.env — this file ships zero deployment-specific hostnames. Server identifier (placeholder `backend`) is the AISHA reference label — operator overrides via SINGLE_HOST_SERVER env. See cloud-single.json.example for the full AISHA reference mapping.
_notes: netbird excluded — single-server has no mesh need; cross-stack Docker DNS works. ledger/exec dropped (Experimental-specific). tier_filter excludes optional by default; opt-in via include[]. OAuth2 cookie/whitelist domains operator-supplied via .env-prod-backup (resolver: env > profile null).

ai._note: Rezidence dat AI (local | hybrid | cloud). Šablona drží dnešní chování platformy; instance s modelem uvnitř meshe deklaruje local.
